strings.en: No good...
Still can't get through, huh?
Yes... Some kind of powerful electromagnetic jamming is at work...
We've lost contact with the Gandor Team. It was fine just a moment ago...
Dammit, what happened to Daisuke and them...? Did they take off okay?
Koji, all we can do now is trust Tetsuya and the others...
Best assume there'll be no reinforcements from the ground.
But...!? Let's trust Koji and the others, Tetsuya.
A colony might be about to fall, so what're you dawdlin' for!?
Geez!
But there's nothing we can do, right? We'll just have to go on our own...
It's always been like that. No point complaining now.
True... Londo Bell has always fought in close-call situations.
Then let's go. We're wasting time.
It can't be helped... Anyway, the shortest route to Earth... Hm?
This is Anaheim Electronics... Nina Purpleton!
Londo Bell, Captain Bright Noa!
Nina!?
Ah... Ms. Purpleton. What is it?
My unit is about to begin operations...
I've heard. About that... the Gundam GP03 Dendrobium's add-on unit...
the Orchis, is complete.
GP03... the Orchis!? Did you say GP03!? Nina!?
Yes. GP03... a machine built for base defense.
If you're going to seize a colony, you'll need at least that much...
I see... We need the extra strength... but is there time, Captain?
So basically there's no time.
The captain's easy to read.
It's meaningless if we don't make it in time... It can't be helped.
Yes... Ms. Purpleton, I appreciate it, but with our current forces
we'll do all we can.
...I understand. I'll at least have it ready.
Nina... I'm sorry.
It's all right, Kou... Good luck.
Isn't that a nice mood?
Don't tease.
You've been sneaking off to make calls in the hangar yourself, Excellen.
Huh? W-Well, yeah. That's just a routine check-in. Routine.
Oh, it's you lot. Hm? If you're contacting me...
have you decided to come back? I want out of this star system, fast.
Too bad, Doctor. We're not coming back for a while.
We've come this far, so we're sticking with these people to the end.
Mia's home planet is in trouble.
...You kids still don't understand how terrifying the Bunker is!
If their main force comes out, we'll be in big trouble!
...And lately the space crime syndicate Gyandlar has joined in too...
...The Gyandlar...! Oh, right, Doctor, do you know anything
about the people chasing the Gyandlar?
They're people who help us out sometimes.
But all we know is that they're on our side...
Chasing the Gyandlar? ...Hmm, plenty would have a grudge against them.
Something Stol from planet Cronos... was it?
Planet Cronos...!? That's the planet the Gyandlar withdrew from before!
Stol... Surely it's not Kirai Stol, is it, you lot!?
Kirai? Nah, I think it was Rom... Yeah, he said Rom Stol.
Who is this Kirai?
Founder of Tenku Chushin Ken, called the strongest martial art in space.
Though I heard he lost his life fighting the Gyandlar.
Then the people who always help us...
Probably members of his clan. Perhaps his son.
...But a Tenku Chushin Ken master, all the way out here!
...Including people like that... I feel like too many things are gathering
on Earth...
...Indeed. I don't fully understand it, but the planet Earth
has one strange thing about it.
Strange thing?
...Mm. The planet Earth itself seems to give off a kind of energy,
something like a force field.
Huh? That makes no sense, Doctor.
Simply put... you can pinpoint Earth from anywhere in this universe.
Mind you, you'd need the proper equipment.
...So the enemies saw that and came to this star system...
Very likely. Especially for drifters like the Bunker or the Gyandlar,
it makes a fine landmark.
What's that mean? Explain it, Doctor.
...I don't know either. It's not that advanced scientifically.
It's just one planet on the frontier, so to speak.
...Earth... my home... I have a bad feeling...
Mia, right now someone's trying to drop a colony on that Earth.
Stopping that comes first, right?
Exactly. Well, thanks, Doctor! We'll call again!
...You have no intention... of coming back?
Ending transmission.
Wait, wait! ...Oh, do as you like! If you're set on Earth,
there's one thing I've found out. I'll tell you that much.
What is it?
That asteroid at what your coordinates call PLS Black Point...
Be careful. Its energy is rising almost by the hour.
...So there was somethin' there after all. Better tell the captain...
Commander Hazard has told us about you. You are Ilbora Saro, yes?
Yes. Then I'll get to the point. That device again...
I would like you to lend it to me.
Whether lending it to you would be of any value to us...
That is what Don is asking.
The Gandor Team, whom you consider as great a nuisance as Londo Bell...
I will cast them out somewhere they can be easily disposed of.
You mean... somewhere easy for you to dispose of them, surely?
Very well... So says Don.
The Commander who used this was indeed defeated in the last war,
and no one uses it anymore. Very well. We shall lend it to you.
Thank you. ...I will surely bring the Gandor Team to ruin.
Reassuring words we haven't heard in a long time... Don is most pleased.
Yes...
(Damn Hazard, why is he tied up with people like these?)
...Yes, we somehow managed to get near the moon, but...
Understood. We'll come to your rescue...!
Thank you so much... I don't know how to thank you...
No, please, there's no need to be so formal. ...I'll send a few people.
Please give my regards to Umon.
Understood... We'll be waiting...
It seems they made it up into space, but...
meeting up at the originally planned point looks impossible.
Who cares?
We were worried they might not make it up here at all.
Let's hurry and meet up with them!
More super robots here is just what we need.
But... they're stranded, aren't they?
More super robots would be welcome, but...
Can we really afford to go rescue them...?
Oh, perfect, everyone's here.
Captain, we found out who those mystery allies... Huh, what's up?
Did something happen?
Yes. We've just made contact with the reinforcements from the ground.
Whoa!? That's great! That'll make things way easier...
Not exactly. They got stranded on the way here.
Their battleship broke down, they said.
...Then meeting up is...
Then we'll just have to go pick them up ourselves.
We have a colony drop to stop... I'd rather not lose any extra time...
I'm aware. But we can't afford to fail at stopping this colony drop.
And Zeon's resistance will be fierce, too.
But we can't just leave Grendizer and the others hanging, either.
Yes... Besides, the point where they're waiting is near the moon...
A gravity zone where derelict colonies gather.
If all goes well... we could even get the GP03's parts from the moon.
Then... let's hurry!
All right, everyone, keep up maintenance on your machines!
...Oh, right, we need to report about PLS Black Point...
You mean... that asteroid!?
Yes. I contacted Dr. Tarsan a moment ago, and...
it sounds like its energy keeps on growing...
That place again!? Should we check it out top to bottom?
If we had the time for that, we wouldn't be struggling. Still...
Hey, he's your guardian, right? This Dr. Tarsan guy.
Can't you have him look into it?
Couldn't this Dr. Tarsan... investigate it for us?
He's your boss, isn't he?
Guardian?
Well, sort of a guardian... But he isn't in this star system.
He's scared of the Bunker noticing him, so he won't come near.
...Geez, after coming this far, he oughta just give up already.
I can't blame him. ...Captain, I've worked out our route, but
the shortest route... will take us right past that asteroid either way.
When we do...
Right. We can't spare time for a survey, but... we'll see then.
Pursuing the colony... It seems it won't be so easy...
